Package io.mavlink4j.codec

Interface SigningKeyResolver

public interface SigningKeyResolver
The sysid→key lookup the library cannot own: which 32-byte secret belongs to which vehicle is the host application's knowledge (a key store, a device registry), so the host supplies the implementation and the library only consumes the interface. See the message signing spec.

Implementer contract: keyFor(int) is called on the receive and send paths for every frame, so it must be fast, non-blocking and thread-safe, and it must never throw; return Optional.empty() when no key is known (the frame is then treated as unverifiable, not invalid). A returned array is read, never retained or mutated by the library.
